name: inkie-deck-workspace
description: Workspace root for Inkie Deck, a web control plane for a fleet of AI agents, and the bundled agent protocol package it is built on

scripts._comment:test: One workspace at a time, deliberately. pnpm -r defaults to running package scripts in parallel, and the base suite drives bin/create-agent.sh as real subprocesses. Run alongside deck's suite, that load alone pushed a dozen of deck's 5-second per-test timeouts over the line: 64 failures, none of them a real defect, on a tree that is green when the two run in sequence. A suite that fails for load reasons is no more use than one that passes for environmental ones.
